Trace, implement and test: leetcode575 distribute candies bool array trade space for time

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<unordered_map>
using namespace std;

const int N = 1e5;
class Solution {
public:
    int distributeCandies(vector<int>& candyType) {
        bool flags[2 * N + 1]; /* 标记当前num是否是重复出现, -10^5 <= candyType[i] <= 10^5 */
        fill(flags, flags + 2 * N + 1, false);
        int count = 0;
        int half = candyType.size() / 2;
        for (auto &candy : candyType)
        {
            candy += N;
            if (!flags[candy])
            {
                if (++count >= half)
                    return count;
                flags[candy] = true;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> candyType = {1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3};
    auto res = sol.distributeCandies(candyType);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
